pricingCaveats: The standard price book has moved at least twice: Jan 2025 (FAQ sheet) → 2025.08.09 artwork → current GiantSoft till. Never quote a price from artwork alone.
Chef's Table runs 16–33% above standard on the same SKU. Tri-Chocolate is 200 standard / 250 CT. Kunaffle is 280 / 350.
Foodpanda menu prices are NOT the same as counter prices and are not captured here. Delivery pricing needs its own extract.
The GiantSoft export used here is a single outlet (Banani). Prices are assumed uniform across standard outlets — UNVERIFIED. Pull one item-sales report per outlet to confirm.

posOnlyCategories.SURPRISE CARD: Issued as a zero-value complimentary line at the till. 1,937 issued in the Banani sample period. This is how distribution gets counted — see programs/SURPRISE-CARD.md.
posOnlyCategories.SURPRISE CARD ITEM: Redemptions, also zero-value complimentary lines, prefixed 'SI '. Current SI SKUs at Banani: SI- Nutella, SI Whipped Cream, SI Ice-Cream, SI Crunchy Chia Pudding, SI Choco Choco Cheese. Note 'SI Crunchy Chia Pudding' has NO product code in the POS — it will fall out of any code-keyed report.
